Summary
: The English translation of the Shrimad Bhagavad-gita, orginally composed by Shrila Krishna Dvaipayana Vedavyasa, presented as the universal teacher and an incarnation of Bhagavan. The Bhagavadgita consists of eighteen chapters embedded in the Bhishma-parva of the Mahabharata.
This edition of the Bhagavad Gita includes Vaishnava commentaries such as the Sarartha-varsini-tika, it’s sub-commentary Prakashika-vritti and excerpts from the Rasika-ranjana.
Other titles: (a) Śrīmad Bhagavad-gītā (श्रीमद् भगवद्-गीता), Śrīmadbhagavadgītā (श्रीमद्भगवद्गीता) by Śrī Śrimad Bhaktivedānta Nārāyaṇa Gosvāmī Mahārāja; (b) Śrīla Viśvanātha Cakravartī Ṭhākura's Sārārtha-varṣiṇī-ṭīkā; (c) Sārārtha-varṣiṇī-prakāśikā-vṛtti; (d) Śrīla Bhaktivinoda Ṭhākura's Rasika-rañjana.
